```{r differential_analysis}
# user config ---------------------------------------------------------------
n_extreme_features <- 20L
plot_adj_p_threshold <- 0.05
plot_t_threshold <- 2
log2fc_cutoffs <- c(0.5, 0.3)
metabolite_label_max_chars <- 30L
write_metabolite_class_volcanoes <- TRUE
results_dir <- "../Results/Differential_Analysis"
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
workbook_path <- file.path(
    results_dir,
    "ExtendedDataTable_DifferentialAnalysis_Shorthouse_LungMutations.xlsx"
)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

shorthouse_intensities <- Shorthouse_2022_extended[["data_matrix"]]
shorthouse_samples <- Shorthouse_2022_extended[["samples"]]
shorthouse_features <- Shorthouse_2022_extended[["features"]]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(shorthouse_intensities), rownames(shorthouse_samples)))

feature_annotations_raw <- as.data.frame(shorthouse_features)
if (nrow(feature_annotations_raw) < ncol(shorthouse_intensities)) {
    stop("Feature metadata has fewer rows than the intensity matrix has columns.")
}

feature_annotations <-
    feature_annotations_raw[seq_len(ncol(shorthouse_intensities)), , drop = FALSE] %>%
    mutate(
        feature_id = colnames(shorthouse_intensities),
        metabolite_name = coalesce(na_if(as.character(name), ""), feature_id),
        metabolite_class = coalesce(na_if(as.character(metabolite_class), ""), "Unclassified")
    )

shorthouse_samples_working <-
    shorthouse_samples %>%
    mutate(
        mutation_tokens = coalesce(as.character(mutation_tokens), ""),
        has_EGFR_mutation = str_detect(mutation_tokens, "(^|;\\s*)EGFR($|;)"),
        has_KRAS_mutation = str_detect(mutation_tokens, "(^|;\\s*)KRAS($|;)"),
        has_CDKN2A_mutation = str_detect(mutation_tokens, "(^|;\\s*)CDKN2A($|;)"),
        has_STK11_mutation = str_detect(mutation_tokens, "(^|;\\s*)STK11($|;)"),
        has_TP53_mutation = str_detect(mutation_tokens, "(^|;\\s*)TP53($|;)")
    )

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

clean_metabolite_label <- function(x, max_chars = 40L) {
    label <- coalesce(as.character(x), "")
    label <- str_split_fixed(label, fixed(";"), 2)[, 1]
    label <- str_trim(label)
    label[label == ""] <- "Unnamed metabolite"

    too_long <- str_length(label) > max_chars
    label[too_long] <- paste0(str_sub(label[too_long], 1, max_chars - 3L), "...")
    label
}

count_source_values <- function(samples_df) {
    source_df <-
        samples_df %>%
        mutate(
            source_value = str_split(coalesce(as.character(mutation_tokens), ""), fixed(";")),
            source_value = lapply(source_value, str_trim)
        ) %>%
        rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
        select(sample_id, source_value) %>%
        unnest(source_value) %>%
        filter(source_value != "") %>%
        distinct(sample_id, source_value)

    if (nrow(source_df) == 0) {
        return(tibble(source_value = character(), n_samples = integer()))
    }

    source_df %>%
        count(source_value, name = "n_samples") %>%
        arrange(desc(n_samples), source_value)
}

save_plot_dual <- function(plot_obj, file_base, width = 8, height = 6) {
    ggsave(
        filename = paste0(file_base, ".svg"),
        plot = plot_obj,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        dpi = 300,
        device = "svg"
    )
    ggsave(
        filename = paste0(file_base, ".png"),
        plot = plot_obj,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        dpi = 300
    )
}

class_legend_theme <- theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.35, "cm")
)

sheet_specs <- list(
    list(
        name = "sample_summary",
        suffix = "summary",
        description = "Sample counts per comparison group.",
        details = "Counts of mutation-positive and mutation-negative samples after applying the cohort filter."
    ),
    list(
        name = "source_counts_all",
        suffix = "src_all",
        description = "Mutation token counts across the full cohort.",
        details = "Counts all mutation tokens among all samples included in the comparison cohort."
    ),
    list(
        name = "source_counts_positive_only",
        suffix = "src_pos",
        description = "Mutation token counts among mutation-positive samples only.",
        details = "Counts all mutation tokens among the mutation-positive subset of the comparison cohort."
    ),
    list(
        name = "limma_results",
        suffix = "limma",
        description = "Full limma differential analysis results.",
        details = "Contains limma statistics and metabolite annotations for all retained metabolites."
    ),
    list(
        name = "extreme_features",
        suffix = "extreme",
        description = "Combined top and bottom differential metabolites.",
        details = "Merged extreme feature set built from the highest and lowest moderated t-statistics without separate top/bottom sheets, including a combined raw-p-value and absolute log2FC threshold flag."
    )
)

volcano_stat_specs <- list(
    adj_p = list(
        value = function(df) df$neg_log10_adj_p,
        flag = function(df) df$adj.P.Val < plot_adj_p_threshold,
        y_label = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
        hline = -log10(plot_adj_p_threshold),
        legend = paste0("adj.P.Val < ", plot_adj_p_threshold),
        title = "adjusted p-value"
    ),
    p_value = list(
        value = function(df) df$neg_log10_p,
        flag = function(df) df$P.Value < plot_adj_p_threshold,
        y_label = "-log10 p-value",
        hline = -log10(plot_adj_p_threshold),
        legend = paste0("P.Value < ", plot_adj_p_threshold),
        title = "raw p-value"
    ),
    t_value = list(
        value = function(df) abs(df$t),
        flag = function(df) abs(df$t) >= plot_t_threshold,
        y_label = "Moderated t-statistic",
        hline = plot_t_threshold,
        legend = paste0("|t| >= ", plot_t_threshold),
        title = "moderated t-statistic"
    )
)

comparison_specs <- list(
    list(
        file_id = "KRAS_all_lung",
        sheet_prefix = "KRAS_all",
        comparison_title = "KRAS vs no_KRAS in all lung cancer cell lines",
        mutation_symbol = "KRAS",
        positive_flag = "has_KRAS_mutation",
        negative_label = "no_KRAS",
        cohort_description = "All lung cancer cell lines",
        cohort_filter = function(df) {
            df %>%
                filter(!is.na(general_site), general_site == "Lung/Pleura")
        }
    ),
    list(
        file_id = "KRAS_TP53pos_EGFRneg_CDKN2Aneg_STK11neg",
        sheet_prefix = "KRAS_filt",
        comparison_title = "KRAS vs no_KRAS in TP53+, EGFR-, CDKN2A-, STK11- lung cancer cell lines",
        mutation_symbol = "KRAS",
        positive_flag = "has_KRAS_mutation",
        negative_label = "no_KRAS",
        cohort_description = "Lung cancer cell lines filtered to TP53+, EGFR-, CDKN2A-, STK11-",
        cohort_filter = function(df) {
            df %>%
                filter(
                    !is.na(general_site),
                    general_site == "Lung/Pleura",
                    has_TP53_mutation,
                    !has_EGFR_mutation,
                    !has_CDKN2A_mutation,
                    !has_STK11_mutation
                )
        }
    ),
    list(
        file_id = "EGFR_all_lung",
        sheet_prefix = "EGFR_all",
        comparison_title = "EGFR vs no_EGFR in all lung cancer cell lines",
        mutation_symbol = "EGFR",
        positive_flag = "has_EGFR_mutation",
        negative_label = "no_EGFR",
        cohort_description = "All lung cancer cell lines",
        cohort_filter = function(df) {
            df %>%
                filter(!is.na(general_site), general_site == "Lung/Pleura")
        }
    ),
    list(
        file_id = "EGFR_TP53pos_KRASneg_CDKN2Aneg_STK11neg",
        sheet_prefix = "EGFR_filt",
        comparison_title = "EGFR vs no_EGFR in TP53+, KRAS-, CDKN2A-, STK11- lung cancer cell lines",
        mutation_symbol = "EGFR",
        positive_flag = "has_EGFR_mutation",
        negative_label = "no_EGFR",
        cohort_description = "Lung cancer cell lines filtered to TP53+, KRAS-, CDKN2A-, STK11-",
        cohort_filter = function(df) {
            df %>%
                filter(
                    !is.na(general_site),
                    general_site == "Lung/Pleura",
                    has_TP53_mutation,
                    !has_KRAS_mutation,
                    !has_CDKN2A_mutation,
                    !has_STK11_mutation
                )
        }
    )
)

run_comparison <- function(spec) {
    comparison_figure_dir <- file.path(figure_dir, spec$file_id)
    dir.create(comparison_figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    analysis_samples <-
        spec$cohort_filter(shorthouse_samples_working) %>%
        mutate(
            has_target_mutation = .data[[spec$positive_flag]],
            comparison_group = factor(
                if_else(has_target_mutation, spec$mutation_symbol, spec$negative_label),
                levels = c(spec$negative_label, spec$mutation_symbol)
            )
        )

    sample_summary <-
        analysis_samples %>%
        count(comparison_group, name = "n_samples")

    if (nrow(sample_summary) != 2 || any(sample_summary$n_samples == 0)) {
        stop(paste0("Comparison ", spec$file_id, " does not contain both groups."))
    }

    source_counts_all <- count_source_values(analysis_samples)
    source_counts_positive_only <- count_source_values(filter(analysis_samples, has_target_mutation))

    analysis_intensities <-
        shorthouse_intensities[
            rownames(analysis_samples),
            ,
            drop = FALSE
        ]

    analysis_matrix_raw <- as.matrix(analysis_intensities)
    storage.mode(analysis_matrix_raw) <- "numeric"

    feature_positive_mask <- colSums(!is.finite(analysis_matrix_raw) | analysis_matrix_raw <= 0) == 0
    analysis_matrix_positive <- analysis_matrix_raw[, feature_positive_mask, drop = FALSE]

    feature_variance_mask <- apply(analysis_matrix_positive, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    analysis_matrix_filtered <- analysis_matrix_positive[, feature_variance_mask, drop = FALSE]

    exprs_log2 <- log2(t(analysis_matrix_filtered))

    retained_feature_ids <- rownames(exprs_log2)
    feature_annotations_current <-
        feature_annotations %>%
        filter(feature_id %in% retained_feature_ids)

    group_values <- analysis_samples$comparison_group
    sample_order <- order(group_values, analysis_samples$name)
    analysis_samples_ordered <- analysis_samples[sample_order, , drop = FALSE]
    exprs_log2_ordered <- exprs_log2[, rownames(analysis_samples_ordered), drop = FALSE]

    plot_boxplot_df <-
        as.data.frame(t(exprs_log2_ordered)) %>%
        rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
        pivot_longer(
            cols = -sample_id,
            names_to = "feature_id",
            values_to = "log2_intensity"
        ) %>%
        left_join(
            analysis_samples_ordered %>%
                rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
                select(sample_id, name, comparison_group),
            by = "sample_id"
        ) %>%
        mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = unique(sample_id)))

    p_boxplot <-
        ggplot(plot_boxplot_df, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_intensity, fill = comparison_group)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.15) +
        labs(
            title = paste0("Log2 intensity distribution: ", spec$comparison_title),
            x = NULL,
            y = "Log2 intensity",
            fill = "Group"
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "top"
        )

    print(p_boxplot)
    save_plot_dual(
        plot_obj = p_boxplot,
        file_base = file.path(comparison_figure_dir, paste0(spec$file_id, "_boxplot")),
        width = 12,
        height = 6
    )

    design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + comparison_group, data = analysis_samples)
    colnames(design) <- make.names(levels(analysis_samples$comparison_group), unique = TRUE)
    contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
        contrasts = paste0(make.names(spec$mutation_symbol), " - ", make.names(spec$negative_label)),
        levels = design
    )

    fit <- lmFit(exprs_log2, design)
    fit <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
    fit <- eBayes(fit)

    limma_results <-
        topTable(
            fit,
            coef = 1,
            number = Inf,
            sort.by = "P"
        ) %>%
        rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
        left_join(feature_annotations_current, by = "feature_id") %>%
        mutate(
            comparison_id = spec$file_id,
            comparison_title = spec$comparison_title,
            cohort_description = spec$cohort_description,
            mutation_of_interest = spec$mutation_symbol,
            negative_group = spec$negative_label,
            comparison_direction = case_when(
                logFC > 0 ~ paste0("Up_in_", spec$mutation_symbol),
                logFC < 0 ~ paste0("Down_in_", spec$negative_label),
                TRUE ~ "Unchanged"
            ),
            plot_label = clean_metabolite_label(metabolite_name, metabolite_label_max_chars),
            neg_log10_p = -log10(pmax(P.Value, .Machine$double.xmin)),
            neg_log10_adj_p = -log10(pmax(adj.P.Val, .Machine$double.xmin))
        ) %>%
        arrange(adj.P.Val, desc(abs(logFC)))

    top_features <-
        limma_results %>%
        arrange(desc(t), P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
        slice_head(n = n_extreme_features)

    bottom_features <-
        limma_results %>%
        arrange(t, P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
        slice_head(n = n_extreme_features)

    extreme_features <-
        bind_rows(top_features, bottom_features) %>%
        distinct(feature_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        mutate(p_value_and_abs_log2fc_pass = abs(logFC) >= 0.5 & P.Value <= 0.05) %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(t)), P.Value, adj.P.Val)

    for (stat_name in names(volcano_stat_specs)) {
        stat_spec <- volcano_stat_specs[[stat_name]]

        volcano_base <-
            limma_results %>%
            mutate(
                plot_metric_value = stat_spec$value(.),
                plot_metric_flag = stat_spec$flag(.),
                plot_metric_label = if_else(plot_metric_flag, "Highlighted", "Background")
            )

        for (log2fc_cutoff in log2fc_cutoffs) {
            cutoff_tag <- str_replace(format(log2fc_cutoff, nsmall = 1), "\\.", "_")
            volcano_df <-
                volcano_base %>%
                mutate(
                    label = if_else(
                        abs(logFC) > log2fc_cutoff | plot_metric_flag,
                        plot_label,
                        NA_character_
                    )
                )

            p_volcano_sig <-
                ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = logFC, y = plot_metric_value, color = plot_metric_label)) +
                geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
                geom_vline(xintercept = c(-log2fc_cutoff, log2fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
                geom_hline(yintercept = stat_spec$hline, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
                geom_text(
                    aes(label = label),
                    size = 3,
                    na.rm = TRUE,
                    check_overlap = TRUE,
                    vjust = -0.5
                ) +
                scale_color_manual(values = c("Highlighted" = "#C44E52", "Background" = "#4C72B0")) +
                labs(
                    title = paste0(
                        "Volcano plot: ",
                        spec$comparison_title,
                        " (",
                        stat_spec$title,
                        ", |log2FC| > ",
                        log2fc_cutoff,
                        ")"
                    ),
                    x = paste0("Log2 fold-change (", spec$mutation_symbol, " - ", spec$negative_label, ")"),
                    y = stat_spec$y_label,
                    color = stat_spec$legend
                ) +
                theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
                theme(legend.position = "top")

            print(p_volcano_sig)
            save_plot_dual(
                plot_obj = p_volcano_sig,
                file_base = file.path(
                    comparison_figure_dir,
                    paste0(spec$file_id, "_volcano_", stat_name, "_fc_", cutoff_tag)
                )
            )

            if (write_metabolite_class_volcanoes) {
                p_volcano_class <-
                    ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = logFC, y = plot_metric_value, color = metabolite_class)) +
                    geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
                    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-log2fc_cutoff, log2fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
                    geom_hline(yintercept = stat_spec$hline, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
                    geom_text(
                        aes(label = label),
                        size = 3,
                        na.rm = TRUE,
                        check_overlap = TRUE,
                        vjust = -0.5
                    ) +
                    labs(
                        title = paste0(
                            "Volcano plot: ",
                            spec$comparison_title,
                            " (",
                            stat_spec$title,
                            ", class-colored, |log2FC| > ",
                            log2fc_cutoff,
                            ")"
                        ),
                        x = paste0("Log2 fold-change (", spec$mutation_symbol, " - ", spec$negative_label, ")"),
                        y = stat_spec$y_label,
                        color = "Metabolite class"
                    ) +
                    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
                    class_legend_theme

                print(p_volcano_class)
                save_plot_dual(
                    plot_obj = p_volcano_class,
                    file_base = file.path(
                        comparison_figure_dir,
                        paste0(spec$file_id, "_volcano_", stat_name, "_fc_", cutoff_tag, "_classcolor")
                    )
                )
            }
        }
    }

    list(
        sample_summary = sample_summary %>% mutate(comparison_id = spec$file_id, comparison_title = spec$comparison_title),
        source_counts_all = source_counts_all %>% mutate(comparison_id = spec$file_id, comparison_title = spec$comparison_title, source_scope = "all_samples"),
        source_counts_positive_only = source_counts_positive_only %>% mutate(comparison_id = spec$file_id, comparison_title = spec$comparison_title, source_scope = "mutation_positive_only"),
        limma_results = limma_results,
        extreme_features = extreme_features,
        retained_feature_summary = tibble(
            comparison_id = spec$file_id,
            comparison_title = spec$comparison_title,
            retained_features = nrow(exprs_log2),
            removed_non_positive_or_non_finite = sum(!feature_positive_mask),
            removed_zero_variance = sum(!feature_variance_mask)
        )
    )
}

comparison_results <- lapply(comparison_specs, run_comparison)
names(comparison_results) <- vapply(comparison_specs, `[[`, character(1), "file_id")

sheet_entries <- list()
for (i in seq_along(comparison_specs)) {
    spec <- comparison_specs[[i]]
    result <- comparison_results[[i]]

    for (sheet_spec in sheet_specs) {
        sheet_name <- paste0(spec$sheet_prefix, "_", sheet_spec$suffix)
        sheet_entries[[length(sheet_entries) + 1L]] <- list(
            name = sheet_name,
            description = paste(spec$comparison_title, "-", sheet_spec$description),
            details = sheet_spec$details,
            data = result[[sheet_spec$name]]
        )
    }
}

all_source_counts <-
    bind_rows(c(
        lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$source_counts_all),
        lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$source_counts_positive_only)
    )) %>%
    select(comparison_id, comparison_title, source_scope, everything())

sheet_entries[[length(sheet_entries) + 1L]] <- list(
    name = "All_source_counts",
    description = "Concatenated source-count tables across all four comparisons.",
    details = "Contains both all-sample and mutation-positive-only source-count outputs with provenance columns.",
    data = all_source_counts
)

sheet_overview <-
    tibble(
        sheet_name = c("SheetOverview", vapply(sheet_entries, `[[`, character(1), "name")),
        description = c(
            "Overview of workbook sheets.",
            vapply(sheet_entries, `[[`, character(1), "description")
        ),
        details = c(
            "Lists each sheet name, the table description, and the content details.",
            vapply(sheet_entries, `[[`, character(1), "details")
        )
    )

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "SheetOverview")
writeData(wb, sheet = "SheetOverview", x = sheet_overview)

for (sheet_entry in sheet_entries) {
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_entry$name)
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_entry$name, x = sheet_entry$data)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, workbook_path, overwrite = TRUE)

retained_feature_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$retained_feature_summary))
sample_summary_all <- bind_rows(lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$sample_summary))
source_counts_all_tables <- bind_rows(lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$source_counts_all))
source_counts_positive_tables <- bind_rows(lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$source_counts_positive_only))
limma_results_all <- bind_rows(lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$limma_results))
extreme_features_all <- bind_rows(lapply(comparison_results, function(x) x$extreme_features))

list(
    retained_feature_summary = retained_feature_summary,
    sample_summary = sample_summary_all,
    source_counts_all = source_counts_all_tables,
    source_counts_positive_only = source_counts_positive_tables,
    limma_results = limma_results_all,
    extreme_features = extreme_features_all,
    workbook_path = workbook_path
)
```
